desc: The TX3 12HDM A1 blends classic pump-action design with a mix of retro styling and modern enhancements making it a go-to firearm for home defense or fun at the range. Inspired by iconic riot shotguns it sports a ventilated heat shield atop the chrome-lined drilled barrel. The receiver comes with an integrated weaver rail that securely mounts the rear ghost-ring sight with a Picatinny rail for mounting optics as needed, and the fiber-optic front makes target acquisition a snap in varying lighting conditions.
